strings.name: Sundar Pichai
strings.role: Google and Alphabet CEO · Internet platforms
strings.summary: Pichai began in materials engineering and product management. At Google he helped develop Chrome, later overseeing Android and leading Google and Alphabet. His responsibilities connect search, mobile operating systems, cloud services and AI, influencing how people access information and developers build applications.
strings.coverageNote: Sources checked through November 13, 2026, with selected career milestones through May 2026. The announcement and effective month of his Google CEO appointment are distinguished; planned products are not recorded as delivered.
strings.facts.fact-01.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.fact-02.label: Education
strings.facts.fact-02.value: IIT Kharagpur; master’s, Stanford University; MBA, Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania
strings.facts.fact-03.label: Associated organizations
strings.facts.fact-03.value: Google and Alphabet; previously worked at Applied Materials and McKinsey
strings.highlights.highlight-01.title: Browser and mobile platforms
strings.highlights.highlight-01.text: Helped develop Chrome and took responsibility for Android in 2013, coordinating widely used software platforms.
strings.highlights.highlight-02.title: Leading Google and Alphabet
strings.highlights.highlight-02.text: Became Google CEO in 2015 and also CEO of parent company Alphabet in 2019.
strings.highlights.highlight-03.title: AI product transition
strings.highlights.highlight-03.text: Helped introduce Gemini and outlined AI-agent applications across Google products at I/O 2026.
strings.timeline.event-01.title: Delivers the I/O keynote
strings.timeline.event-01.text: Presented Gemini and AI-agent product directions; announced plans should be distinguished from actual delivery.
strings.timeline.event-02.title: Introduces Gemini
strings.timeline.event-02.text: Presented Gemini with the Google DeepMind team, advancing AI capabilities across Google products.
strings.timeline.event-03.title: Also becomes Alphabet CEO
strings.timeline.event-03.text: Larry Page and Sergey Brin announced management changes, putting him in charge of Google and its parent.
strings.timeline.event-04.title: Becomes Google CEO
strings.timeline.event-04.text: Assumed the role following Alphabet’s restructuring; the appointment had been announced that August.
strings.timeline.event-05.title: Takes responsibility for Android
strings.timeline.event-05.text: Added Android leadership to his existing responsibilities for Chrome and applications.
strings.timeline.event-06.title: Helps launch Chrome
strings.timeline.event-06.text: Led the team advancing the Chrome browser, moving from product management into broader platform leadership.
strings.timeline.event-07.title: Joins Google
strings.timeline.event-07.text: Began product-management work, later overseeing products including Toolbar and Chrome.
strings.timeline.event-08.title: Completes his Wharton MBA
strings.timeline.event-08.text: Earned a master’s in business administration at the University of Pennsylvania’s Wharton School.
strings.timeline.event-09.title: Earns a Stanford master’s
strings.timeline.event-09.text: Completed a master’s degree in materials science and engineering at Stanford University.
strings.timeline.event-10.title: Born in India
strings.timeline.event-10.text: Born in Tamil Nadu and raised in Chennai, later moving to the United States for further study.
